retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
INSIDER THREAT

DESCRIPTION:
An insider threat involves authorized users intentionally or unintentionally causing harm to an organization through misuse of access, data theft, sabotage, negligence, or policy violations.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1534 | Internal Spearphishing (related insider behavior)

INDICATORS:
- Excessive data downloads
- Unauthorized file transfers
- Access outside normal working hours
- Privilege misuse
- Unusual system activity

DETECTION RULES:
- Large file downloads
- Unusual login behavior
- Sensitive file access anomalies

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Internal systems
- Sensitive databases
- Corporate repositories
title: INSIDER THREAT
